objects.name: Analytic 1840
objects.description: For Android, detect Data from Local System from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; File Access via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App reads files across $MinDirectoryCount$+ distinct parent directories with file_read_count > $FileReadRateThreshold$ within $DataCollectionWindow$ in background or low-interaction state — bulk cross-directory read is the collection signal]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App invokes ContentResolver or SAF (Storage Access Framework) queries across multiple user-data paths outside its own sandbox in background state]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Approved backup, sync, file manager, and media apps. Derive from MDM catalog. Tightening: strict list — any unapproved app with broad file access is flagged.
Default 50 file reads within window across 3+ directories. Derive from approved backup app baseline. Tightening: 10 reads — catches targeted collection.
Default 3 distinct parent directories. Single-directory reads may be legitimate (photo editor); cross-directory reads indicate collection sweep.
